# KOTEKULE — WorldFace Super App

> KOTEKULE is the center of the WorldFace (NexaFace) ecosystem: one account connecting a
> social feed, real-time chat and video calls, the NexaPay wallet and creator payouts,
> music, marketplace, app store, ads manager, CulturalVerse heritage platform and the
> WorldFace AI Core. Built by Samwel Misori (King Misori). Languages: Swahili and English.
> Installable PWA with offline support and push notifications.

## Core pages
- [KOTEKULE hub](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/kotekule): directory of every WorldFace app.
- [Feed](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/): posts, reels and stories.
- [Explore](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/explore): people, hashtags and trending content.
- [Communities](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/communities): public, private and secret groups.
- [CulturalVerse](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/culturalverse): cultural map, museums, recipes, heritage music, fashion.
- [Inbox](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/messages): real-time chat, voice and video calls.
- [Live](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/live): livestreaming with gifts.

## Money
- [NexaPay Wallet](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/wallet): balance, payments, mobile money.
- [Payouts](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/payouts): creator payout methods, OTP verification, revenue analytics. Currencies: KES, USD, EUR, GBP, TZS, UGX, NGN, ZAR.
- [Rewards](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/rewards): coins and daily rewards.

## AI
- [NexaAI](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/ai): AI Core across 8 modules (core, feed, chat, pay, studio, search, ads, care).
- [AI Assistant](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/assistant): voice assistant with speech-to-text, text-to-speech and saved history.
- Consent model: the AI has no control until the user grants a scope (memory, feed, chat, wallet, studio, ads, care, personalized ads). It proposes actions; the user approves them. It never sends money or publishes on its own.

## Creator & commerce
- [Studio](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/studio): AI video, images and thumbnails.
- [Music](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/music): artists, songs, lyrics.
- [AppStore](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/appstore): in-app apps and APKs with reviews.
- [Marketplace](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/marketplace): listings with buyer-seller chat.
- [Ads Manager](https://worldface-kotekule.lovable.app/ads): AI-estimated CPM, budget, reach; ads run only inside the app.
